$comment: The structure decided for the three Safix surfaces: marketing at the apex, app and docs on subdomains. Set `domain` once the apex is registered and every surface, every cross-link, every canonical URL and every social preview follows from it. Until then each surface keeps the generated hostname recorded in `currentUrl`. NEXT_PUBLIC_SAFIX_DOMAIN overrides `domain` at build time.
